intro.subtitle: 叮叮當！敲壞不用賠！
intro.text:
[VOICE CHARACTER: A 55-year-old male Taiwanese night-market hammer-game stall owner, calling loudly across a busy outdoor stall. Very low, thick, coarse, gravelly baritone; audible raspy vocal edge, chest resonance and a big diaphragm-supported projection. Rough everyday street delivery, relaxed local swagger, cheeky and friendly. LANGUAGE: Native Taiwan Taiwanese Hokkien / Tai-gi, colloquial southern Taiwan rhythm, natural tone sandhi. Read the Tai-lo romanized script as spoken Taiwanese, never as English syllables. PERFORMANCE: Speak to a player standing at your stall, with punchy consonants and broad, earthy intonation. Maintain the same hefty older male character, even while teasing. Dry solo speech, no background crowd, no music, no added words, do not read instructions. Bark the three TING TING TANG bell calls forcefully with a rough, percussive attack, then boom the invitation in one breath like attracting customers at a real Taiwanese night market. Bold chest shout, not a smooth announcer. Rough smile at the end. 2.5 to 3.5 seconds.]
Ting-ting-tang! Kòng-pháinn bián puê!

success.subtitle: 保利達 B！！
success.text:
[VOICE CHARACTER: A 55-year-old male Taiwanese night-market hammer-game stall owner, calling loudly across a busy outdoor stall. Very low, thick, coarse, gravelly baritone; audible raspy vocal edge, chest resonance and a big diaphragm-supported projection. Rough everyday street delivery, relaxed local swagger, cheeky and friendly. LANGUAGE: Native Taiwan Taiwanese Hokkien / Tai-gi, colloquial southern Taiwan rhythm, natural tone sandhi. Read the Tai-lo romanized script as spoken Taiwanese, never as English syllables. PERFORMANCE: Speak to a player standing at your stall, with punchy consonants and broad, earthy intonation. Maintain the same hefty older male character, even while teasing. Dry solo speech, no background crowd, no music, no added words, do not read instructions. MAXIMUM ENERGY VICTORY BELLOW. Start abruptly at full chest power, bark PO-LIK-TAT as three heavy, connected punches, a tiny dramatic beat, then explode into a huge roaring BEEE for about 0.6 seconds. Dark raspy male chest roar with breath pressure and a sharp attack, not a high-pitched scream and not ordinary speech. Pronounce the brand Paolyta B in Taiwanese, B as English bee. Make it sound like a night-market boss celebrating a knockout. One explosive phrase, 1.5 to 2.2 seconds.]
Pó-li̍k-ta̍t... B!!!
